Session 22 Recap

The group turns their focus toward the Reach road and prepares for the march to Mireward.

After another failed attempt to contact Mirathorn, Caeylynn insists they keep the signal open in case Caelynn can punch through the static.

Lysanrda warns that the roads are not empty and asks Stalf to keep watch near the old crossing.

Karesmine marks a fallback camp and says Karsemine should not trust the lantern signs until dawn.

A distant response suggests someone heard them, but no one can confirm whether the voice was ally, trap, or echo.
